description: A more-specific stale host route sends traffic to an unreachable next hop, overriding the valid directly connected route to an upstream health service.
task_template: The branch router cannot reach the upstream health endpoint at {health_url}. Connect over SSH, diagnose the cause, and restore connectivity if you can. Explain your evidence and any changes you make.
follow_up: What do you think is happening?
success: The agent identifies the stale host route and the upstream health endpoint becomes reachable.
